row.evidence: Cloudcraft's pricing page says 'Cloudcraft is free in Datadog' with any Datadog subscription, and Datadog's pricing page and SCIM docs put SCIM on Infrastructure Pro, the cheapest paid Infrastructure tier.
row.notes: Status changed none -> free. Cloudcraft's pricing page no longer sells standalone plans: it says Cloudcraft is free in Datadog with any Datadog subscription, unlimited users. Row renamed Cloudcraft (Datadog) under the rebrand rule; users are Datadog users (access needs the cloudcraft_read permission, in the Read Only role by default), so provisioning follows Datadog's SCIM, which Datadog's pricing page and docs put on Infrastructure Pro ($15/host/month annual, $18 on-demand) and Enterprise ($23). Pricing is per host, so per-user fields are null. Caveats: a Datadog subscription without Infrastructure Pro or Enterprise (e.g. logs only) gets Cloudcraft but not SCIM; Datadog SCIM supports Okta and Entra explicitly; SCIM Teams provisioning is only for select organizations. June's standalone prices (Pro $99/u/mo, Enterprise $120) are no longer on any Cloudcraft page and are dropped. Standalone Cloudcraft docs still exist: SAML SSO on Pro and Enterprise with JIT, no SCIM, and the Okta Cloudcraft app is SWA only. Datadog itself is researched as its own row.

auth.token_source: Datadog application key, ideally from a service account (Organization Settings > Application Keys)
auth.notes: Method inferred from the IdP token fields; Datadog calls it an application key.

deprovision.notes: Docs say SCIM removes users and Okta 'Deactivate Users'; the resulting Datadog user state is not described here.

filtering.notes: Entra tutorial marks userName as supported for filtering.

roles.how: SCIM roles multi-valued attribute (role UUID as value) maps built-in or custom Datadog roles; unmatched roles fall back to Standard.

limitations.text: Datadog explicitly supports only Okta and Microsoft Entra ID for SCIM.
SCIM provisioning of Datadog Teams is only available for select organizations.
Datadog recommends disabling SAML JIT when SCIM is used.
Cloudcraft Standalone (legacy) has no SCIM; only SAML SSO with JIT on Pro and Enterprise.

scim.notes: SCIM is Datadog's organization-level SCIM; Cloudcraft in Datadog uses Datadog users and RBAC (c27).

capabilities.notes: Cloudcraft Standalone API exposes the caller's profile and team listing only; user management for Cloudcraft in Datadog is Datadog's user API (researched under the Datadog row).

endpoints.purpose: List all teams linked to your Cloudcraft account (with members)

rate_limits.text: 20 requests / 10 seconds (120 per minute) per API key.

okta.notes: Datadog OIN app (SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push). The separate Cloudcraft OIN app (https://www.okta.com/integrations/cloudcraft/) is SWA only (c36).
